title: Chaos Cubed Expansion
description: Expansion of the Chaos Cubed 26.2 Drop
body:
# Chaos Cubed Expansion

### Done
- Blue fire on sulfur blocks
- Sulfur powder recipe
- Sulfur powder on farmland to grow faster
- Sulfur cube interaction with other blocks
  - Redstone block : provide redstone power
  - Note block : punch to get a note sound
  - Blocks that emits light : sulfur cube emits light
### TODO
- Change blue fire to custom blue fire (it is soul fire)
- Neoforge port
- Sulfur light blocks
- Hot Spring
- Geyser
### TODO (maybe)
- Frog interaction
- Chiseled version of blocks

Do not hesite to ask for anything you would like to add in this mod.

This mod is inspired from Nekoma's ideas
